data.title: Personal liability insurance policy – Amendment No. 1
data.summary: Muster Versicherung AG sent an updated policy (Nachtrag Nr. 1) for your personal liability insurance, reflecting your new address and bank details. The annual premium of €59.90 will be debited on 1 December 2026.
data.explanation: This is an updated insurance certificate (Versicherungsschein) for your private liability insurance. It replaces the one from 24 November 2023 and records your new address and bank account. Nothing needs to be paid by you: the yearly premium of €59.90 is collected by direct debit on 1 December 2026. The contract renews by one year each time unless you cancel in text form at least three months before the end of the insurance year (30 November). The app tracks that cancellation window. Check that the address and bank details are correct.
